The main takeaway from our work is that
PRMT5 is an essential regulator of normal B cell biology, with distinct roles in each B cell stage.
Prmt5, which is overexpressed and essential for B cell lymphomagenesis, has essential and distinct functions in normal B cell development and function.
Prmt5 has multiple essential functions in the development of B cell progenitors, in the survival and activation of mature B cells, and in the expansion and maintenance of germinal center B cells.
